source: ADR-0036, 2026-09-28: a fingerprint difference that follows a change of endpoint, or of the fields an adapter reads, is ours, and is recorded with its date and the change that caused it. Add an entry in the same commit as the change, naming every field of the contract check's fingerprint it moves, as <section>.<field>.

rebaselines.cause: ADR-0053: Himalayas is polled through its search endpoint instead of the browse feed, so the check fingerprints a different response. Nothing changed at Himalayas.
The adapter now reads seniority, the level Himalayas states, for the level rule the operator decided on 2026-10-02, so the check fingerprints one more field. Nothing changed at Himalayas.
